roster_grade.headline: 17-3 in Week 10, most points, #1 in title odds. RB is still the only soft spot: turn the bench QB into Jeremiyah Love before the playoffs
roster_grade.window_explanation: #1 composite title odds in Week 10: #1 by record (17-3), #1 in points for (1,504), #3 by roster value. That's a win-now team. Keep every producing starter (Mahomes, Shough, McCaffrey, Henry, Javonte, Hubbard, Higgins, Watson, Parker Washington, Loveland) and spend true surplus (the bench QB, DeVonta Smith, Malik Washington, Jalon Daniels, Kamara, picks) on the one real need: an aging RB room (need 0.4, aging 1.0).

strengths.label: Best record and most points
strengths.detail: 17-3 with 1,504 points for. Four games clear of the 13-7 pack (Rolling Ball, dickcole2410, Phil's) and 134 points ahead of dickcole2410 (1,370) for the PF lead.

strengths.label: Three startable QBs
strengths.detail: Mahomes and Shough are in the lineup with Bo Nix (3,904) on the bench and Jalon Daniels behind him. Superflex starts two, so one of Nix or Shough is a trade chip. QB need is 0.0.

strengths.label: WRs are producing above their offenses
strengths.detail: Higgins (CIN +4.2 vs Vegas), Parker Washington (JAX +4.2), and Watson start, with DeVonta Smith (2,753) and Malik Washington on the bench. WR need is 0.0.

strengths.label: TE is set
strengths.detail: Colston Loveland (3,906), Hockenson, and Gunnar Helm. TE need is 0.0.

weaknesses.label: Aging RB room
weaknesses.detail: McCaffrey (30), Henry (32), Javonte (26), Hubbard (27), and Kamara (31) are all Declining. RB need is 0.4 with an aging score of 1.0, the only real need on the roster.

weaknesses.label: Thin RB depth for the playoffs
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey is still on IR, so one RB injury puts Kamara (983) or a taxi rookie in the lineup.

weaknesses.label: Henry is the RB starter running cold
weaknesses.detail: Baltimore is 2.7 a game under Vegas, while McCaffrey's San Francisco is 4.3 over. Expect McCaffrey to cool and Henry to bounce; both stay holds.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Sell the bench QB to Undefeated In My Dreams (1-19, Long shot, Dart on IR): Bo Nix + Malik Washington for Jeremiyah Love. If you'd rather keep Nix and move Shough (your stated first chip), Shough + Malik Washington is the same deal at fair value; just start Nix. Add DeVonta Smith for Omarion Hampton in the same deal if they'll bite. Keep Mahomes and every producing starter.

QB.commentary: Mahomes and Shough start, Nix and Daniels sit. One of Nix/Shough is the trade chip; Daniels is a package piece. Mahomes is off limits.

RB.commentary: McCaffrey, Javonte, Henry, and Hubbard start, but all are Declining and Harvey is on IR. This is the position to upgrade (need 0.4).

WR.commentary: Higgins, Watson, and Parker Washington start; Higgins and Washington are on offenses running 4.2 over Vegas, so hold them for the title run rather than chase a sell-high. DeVonta Smith is the WR to move.

TE.commentary: Loveland is the long-term TE1 with Hockenson and Helm behind him. Helm is in the lineup slot this week over Loveland; double-check that's intentional.

trade_priority_order: Bo Nix + Malik Washington → Jeremiyah Love (Undefeated In My Dreams, 1-19, Long shot, Dart on IR). Or swap Shough in for Nix and start Nix.
DeVonta Smith → Omarion Hampton (same team; Chargers 5.7 a game under Vegas, the top buy-low at your need). Bundle with the Love deal if possible.
2027 2nd + 2028 2nd + Zavion Thomas → Breece Hall (Bijan Mustard, 5-15, Long shot, selling). Picks are currency for a 17-3 team.
Sell Kamara to Rolling Ball (13-7, weak at RB, buying) for a 2027 4th once one of the RBs above lands.
All-in alternative to the Love deal: Bo Nix + Javonte Williams + 2027 2nd + 2028 3rd → Bijan Robinson (Bijan Mustard).
Hold Mahomes, McCaffrey, Henry, Hubbard, Shough, Loveland, and the starting WRs. You're 17-3.

sell_now.reason: On the bench behind Mahomes and Shough, worth 3,904 and flagged as QB surplus. Superflex rebuilders pay for a starting QB.
On the bench behind Higgins, Watson, and Parker Washington. WR need is 0.0, so he's true surplus.
Bench WR who evens out the QB-for-Love deal and helps their weak WR room.
31-year-old bench RB whose value only drops, but he's the top healthy RB backup while Harvey is on IR.

buy_now.reason: 1-19 Long shot, flagged as selling, with Dart on IR. A starting QB and a WR fill their two biggest holes.
buy_now.offer: Bo Nix + Malik Washington (or Tyler Shough + Malik Washington)

buy_now.reason: Same seller, weak at WR. The Chargers are 15.1 a game against a 20.8 Vegas average, so Hampton's price is depressed.
5-15 Long shot, flagged as selling. A 25-year-old starter for picks you don't need in a title run.
The all-in, as an alternative to the Love deal. They're weak at QB, so the bench QB headlines it. Mahomes, McCaffrey, Henry, and Shough all stay.

do_not_trade: Christian McCaffrey (starting RB on a 17-3 team)
Tee Higgins / Christian Watson / Parker Washington (starting WRs)
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: You're 17-3, so picks are currency. Spend the two 2027 2nds and the 2028 2nd/3rd closing RB deals. Hold the extra 2028 1st unless it lands Bijan or Love outright.

outlook.projected_power_rank: #1 composite title odds (#1 record, #1 PF, #3 value). Top seed if the lineup holds.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Win now with the Mahomes/McCaffrey/Loveland/WR core. Adding a young RB this season (Love, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan) also covers 2027, when McCaffrey, Henry, and Kamara age out.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 17-3 in Week 10: best record, most points (1,504), and #1 in title odds. The only real need is an aging RB room. A bench QB, DeVonta Smith, and spare picks can buy a younger RB from one of the Long shot sellers without weakening the lineup.
key_risks: Regression: McCaffrey, Higgins, and Parker Washington are on offenses scoring 4+ a game over Vegas
An RB injury, with Harvey still on IR
Rolling Ball (13-7, weak at RB, buying) is competing for the same sellers' RBs
key_upside_factors: Landing Love, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan turns RB into a strength for the playoffs
Henry's Baltimore offense is 2.7 a game under Vegas, so expect a bounce
Stribling and Harvey coming back from IR add depth

teams_to_watch.why: 13-7 and second in points (1,370). The most dangerous playoff opponent.
13-7 contender, weak at RB and buying. A rival for sellers' RBs, but a buyer for Kamara.
14-6 contender with Chase, Nabers, and Walker. A rival, not a trade partner.
1-19 seller with Dart on IR. Holds Jeremiyah Love and Omarion Hampton; a QB is the key.
5-15 seller weak at QB. Holds Bijan Robinson and Breece Hall.
13-7 but rated Long shot on points (1,115) and built like a rebuilder. Treat as a playoff team, not a seller.
